metadata.title: Regional nearshore display fill — not surveyed
metadata.source: NOAA/NCEI Southern California Coastal Relief Model v2, 1 arc-second
metadata.reference_water_level_note: Water 0 m (reference, not live tide). Regional datum untransformed; visual edge tie to H12617 MLLW only.

datum_conversion.reason: No source/epoch-specific verified datum grid supplied; do not infer a NAVD88/MSL/MLLW engineering tie.

metadata.native_resolution: 1 arc-second CRM (~26×31 m); finer display sampling is interpolation
metadata.display_processing: Masked 3×3 Gaussian on regional elevations; distance-field edge interpolation into unmeasured cells only
metadata.intended_use: Regional model fill (not surveyed). Not for navigation. H12617 data are untouched; renderer excludes survey-supported cells.
